title: Make sure our VSCODE is working and we reuse as much as we can between plugins
description: Make sure our VSCODE is working and we reuse as much as we can between plugins
architectureNotes:
Reuse decision (VSC-0, task-a3e414a3; full write-up in docs/plans/2026-11-02-vscode-reuse.md). Keep two native UIs (Kotlin/Swing in JetBrains, TypeScript webviews and tree views in VS Code) and share behaviour, not code:
1. Client-neutral golden corpora: moe-jetbrains/src/test/resources/client-*.json, each executed by a Kotlin test AND a moe-vscode test, extending CQ-I06b's client-verdicts.json. JetBrains writes the corpus first. A row the clients disagree on is fixed or filed, never given a client-specific expectation, and consumer rows never edit the corpus.
2. Shared English strings: VS Code consumer tests assert their labels equal moe-jetbrains/src/main/resources/messages/MoeBundle.properties.
3. One bundle manifest, scripts/bundle-manifest.json, read by both plugin builds.
4. Both plugins keep launching agents through the bundled scripts/moe-agent.{ps1,sh}.
Rejected: a JCEF-hosted shared web UI in JetBrains (rewrites the primary IDE's UI); a shared TypeScript client-core package (only VS Code could consume it); computing presentation in the daemon and sending it on the wire (needs SCHEMA/MCP_SERVER doc changes, which are frozen for this epic).
Gates: VS Code npm runs only in a git-archive snapshot of the whole repo (`npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run lint && npm run compile && npm test`; `npm run package` also needs a snapshot path with no UUID-shaped segment, because npm 12 redacts UUIDs in `npm list` output and vsce then packages nothing). JetBrains runs `gradlew.bat test` from cmd.exe in a /mnt/d/moe-scratch snapshot under the jetbrains-gradle lease. VS Code harness trap: panels, providers and MoeDaemonClient load under node:vm with strict require maps, so new runtime helpers stay inside the file that uses them.
Baseline at 882a4c39: VS Code lint 0, compile 0, 388 tests (384 pass, 4 skip, 0 fail); vsix packages (4105 files, 61.37 MB) and its bundled daemon passes scripts/tests/onboarding.mjs.
epicRails: Files to avoid (open wrapper-lane and worktree rows own them): never plan or edit scripts/moe-agent.sh, scripts/moe-agent.ps1, scripts/tests/postflight*, scripts/tests/worktree-*, CLAUDE.md, scripts/CLAUDE.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/roles/**, docs/MCP_SERVER.md, docs/SCHEMA.md, docs/CONFIGURATION.md, docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md or packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/initFiles.ts.
JetBrains first: a change to moe-jetbrains passes `gradlew.bat test` on native Windows under the jetbrains-gradle lease, and no reuse change may regress JetBrains.
